commands.result: All six author groups pass independently, including current compiler source checking in 10.61s.

25 independent real-source cases through an isolated reviewer driver and accepted M3: 20 controls pass (one explicitly recorded C0 namespace defect), five failures expose four blocking F defects. Driver does not use product main or future I implementation.

findings.problem: Reading mutable static array .len bypasses access(base). static mut A:[2]u8=[0;2]; fn run()->u32{return A.len as u32;} compiles and exits 2, while C0 correctly rejects unsafe access.
findings.required_change: Enforce required unsafe access on array length projection, including nested mutable-static array fields; retain safe immutable-array and explicit-unsafe controls.

findings.problem: A legal usize array count 4294967296 exceeds the chosen u32 count representation but is diagnosed E_TYPE. The repeat-expression path uses the same condition. This is an implementation limit, not a language type error.
findings.required_change: Separate wrong count type from count capacity. Report I_LIMIT with actual/capacity/location when integer counts exceed 4294967295, preserving true E_TYPE cases.

findings.problem: Postfix chains bypass expression depth guard through is_place/place recursion. A source returning a.x repeated 3000 times and a[0] repeated 3000 times both crash the RV64 compiler with SIGSEGV under its required 1 MiB stack, instead of a checked diagnostic. AST counts remain below the declared arena limit.
findings.required_change: Bound or remove recursive place/classification walks; all externally constructible expression shapes must fail with a source diagnostic/resource limit before guest stack overflow. Add both field and index-chain regressions.

findings.problem: types::intern correctly detects oversized array multiplication, then recomputes the overflowing multiplication to print actual. A Big structure of 256 fields each [67108864]u8 used as [4294967295]Big triggers compiler panic exit 101 with no diagnostic.
findings.required_change: Make limit reporting itself overflow-safe; report an explicit lower bound/saturated observed value when exact required size is unrepresentable, with capacity and source location. Ensure aggregate size accumulation/alignment has the same bounded behavior.

verified_behavior: Independent target execution agrees with C0 for aggregate argument and return snapshots, RHS-before-LHS assignment with captured calls, defer LIFO/late binding/nested branches and loop break/continue, Result ? and aggregate error snapshots, short circuit, bounds and slice projection.
Negative const-loss, unsafe-global reads and defer returns are rejected; actual target code generation is exercised using accepted M3.

A same-name local incorrectly shadows root::n in C0 (returns77), while F correctly reads global n (returns81). The equivalent renamed-local program returns81 on both. This known seed bug is recorded, not treated as an F blocker or hidden differential pass.
nonblocking_notes: F compact multi-statement formatting must be disclosed in final scale comparisons.
Known C0 root-qualified name shadowing defect and numeric-separator defect need explicit treatment in final differential report; do not force F to reproduce these defects.
limitations: F1 not accepted; downstream I formal execution must wait for accepted F revision.
